cohort: Explicit candidate_mapping.csv; old review labels linked to current own locations, with new independently selected larger candidates where available.
method: Upward vertical verified from StationXML. Polarity raw counts and VEL, no additional bandpass. S/P = peak three-component velocity norm in P to min(P+.30,S-.10) and S to S+.50; 1–15 Hz 4-pole zero-phase. Noise P-3 to P-1; both peak/noise RMS >=3. Window/filter choices are exploratory; S/P and additional arrival identity need review.
amplitude_clipping_check: Reject possible clipping if a raw P-through-S+.5 s component has >=3 consecutive extrema samples and peak-to-peak range >100 counts. Conservative exploratory QA, not a recovered Tan setting or proof of instrument saturation. Polarity remains a separate visual judgment.
